title: Closeness of functions
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\beta$ be a set with decidable equality, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\beta$. They are close at tolerance $\varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}$ when their relative Hamming distance is at most $\varepsilon$.
